canonical_project: CtrlS Data Centre Park, Chandanvelly Industrial Park (up to 600MW)
notes: CtrlS announced (Jan 2025) a 40-acre data centre park at the upcoming Chandanvelly Industrial Park near Hyderabad (Ranga Reddy district), with potential IT load of ~600MW when fully developed across multiple AI-ready, high-density buildings. CtrlS also signed an MoU with the Telangana government (at WEF Davos, Jan 2025) for an AI-ready data centre cluster with proposed investment of over Rs 10,000 crore.
